thesis: A low-debt financial-software franchise with ROIC, operating and FCF margins at their 2-year highs trades below its own 5-year minimum multiples at a 12.68% FCF yield, pricing a revenue decline its results do not show.
reason: Fundamentals are at their best, yet the price implies shrinkage; the guidance cut and AI-disintermediation risk are real but not yet visible in margins or cash. The scorecard sets the conviction; the position keeps its size, with no ADD while the guidance cut is unexplained by a primary source.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 16%, giving up most of the rise from 18.7% a year earlier to 22.7%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 30%, back near the FY2024 level of 28.8%, meaning the cash step-up was transitory.
TTM gross margin falls below 78%, under the FY2023 five-year low of 79.3%, signalling free or AI-native rivals are forcing price cuts.
Consumer segment revenue (10-Q) declines year on year for two consecutive reported periods, showing free filing and AI eroding the TurboTax base.
